name: Fractal
description: Self-similar all the way down: the inner grid uses the same open-or-shut rule as the outer one.
svgExportNote: The nested mask is exported as clean vector shapes - the faint seams visible on screen come from browser rasterization and won't appear in the SVG, so it can differ from the screen by a hair.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @doodle(@grid: 3 / 100%; background: #000; @nth(5) { background: #0000; }); mask: @doodle(@grid: 3 / 100%; background: #000; @nth(5) { background: #0000; }); -webkit-mask-size: 100% 100%; mask-size: 100% 100%; } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
